limitations: C01: Pixels come from the fixture build's own WKWebView snapshot (the rendered page), not a screen capture; native window chrome and menus are verified through AX.
C01: Spoken VoiceOver output was not recorded; C01-N08 inspects the accessibility attributes VoiceOver consumes.
C01: Startup network evidence is sampled lsof output, not a packet capture.

C02: The fixture build stores credentials in a dedicated fixture test keychain (DESIGN); the production login-keychain path is qualified by keychain_access (read-only availability) and, with signing, in C26.
C02: Keychain items are inspected by attributes only (security dump-keychain without -d); stored secrets are never read back.
C02: v1 isolation is evidenced by unchanged Application Support metadata (path, size, mtime); the login keychain is not enumerated.
C02: Spoken VoiceOver output was not recorded; AX roles, names and focus are inspected.
C02: Startup network evidence is sampled lsof output, not a packet capture.
C02: That a referenced credential file is never opened is shown by the core tests and the absent file; file-system tracing was not recorded.

C02: A trial run locked the fixture keychain from another process (`security lock-keychain`); the running app did not observe that lock and its writes still succeeded (macOS 27; retained under native-trial/). C02-N07 therefore locks through the app's own keychain reference (fixture-only menu item), which exercises the app's real locked-store path.
C03: The endpoint is a local synthetic fixture with a disposable test CA trusted only by the fixture build; live Prisma AIRS behavior is qualified in C25.

C03: v1-sized input is typed as key events posted to the app's process (20 characters per event) because System Events typing is too slow for 96 KiB and the WebView ignores accessibility value writes; smaller inputs are typed through System Events. The 2 MiB and 8 MiB refusals are covered by scan-submit.test.tsx and sync_scan, not natively.
C03: Offline is simulated by a stopped local endpoint (connection refused), not by disabling the host network.
C03: Spoken VoiceOver output was not recorded; AX roles, names, focus and live status regions are inspected.
